mapper.update: UPDATE teaching_task SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_expire_at = #{leaseExpireAt}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = NULL, last_error = NULL, retry_count = retry_count + 1 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND ( status IN ('CREATED', 'RETRYING') OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expire_at < #{startedAt}) )

UPDATE teaching_task SET status = 'RETRYING', response_json = #{responseJson}, retry_count = 0, lease_owner = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_expire_at = NULL, current_stage = NULL, last_error = NULL, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND ( status IN ('FAILED', 'RETRYING', 'COMPLETED') OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND (lease_expire_at IS NULL OR lease_expire_at < #{updatedAt})) )

UPDATE teaching_task SET response_json = #{responseJson}, current_stage = #{currentStage}, status = 'COMPLETED', lease_owner = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_expire_at = NULL, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken}

UPDATE teaching_task SET response_json = #{responseJson}, status = #{status}, last_error = #{error}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_expire_at = NULL, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken}
